controls: Null sample A: 31 independent random-scalar sign-complete factor bases per curve.
Null sample B: 31 independent random-x sign-complete factor bases per curve from the same point-set null using the coordinate construction path.
Order control: exact uniform-permutation first-hit expectation per target plus four preregistered deterministic permutations.
Mandatory compression control: scalar progression must have smaller four-term support and lower eight-term coverage than random medians.
Curve/field control: generator and verifier independently reject trace 0 or 1, j 0 or 1728, repeated field primes, and nonmonotone q.
Cost control: coordinate exponentiation, RHS arithmetic, and map multiplication/inversion proxies are charged separately from group operations.
Execution control: exact argv, run graph, clean tree, source hashes, timeout, memory, CPU, and result linkage are harness-enforced.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Narrow H-ECDLP-RECURSIVE-002 if no coordinate family meets both-sample support, coverage-efficiency, exact uniform-order frontier, charged offline-cost, and six-of-nine scheduled-curve gates; do not infer which mechanism caused failure.

inputs.field_modulus_policy: Nine distinct seeded bit-size primes constrained to p mod 4 = 3; curves with trace 0 or 1 and j 0 or 1728 are rejected.

invalidation_rules: Any curve has trace 0 or 1, j 0 or 1728, composite order, cofactor above 1, a repeated field prime, or nonmonotone q for a seed.
Any null family has fewer than 31 independently seeded replicates on any curve.
Any exact four- or eight-term support, target first-hit expectation, target witness, charged cost, raw rank/tie count, source hash, or percentile fails independent reconstruction.
Any Boolean or floating-point value occupies an exact integer protocol field.
Any positive, order, curve, field, global-seed, rho, resource, exact-command, predecessor-linkage, or verifier control fails.
Canonical generator or verifier run records a dirty Git tree or departs from the frozen execution plan.
A candidate is promoted from one null sample, a sampled order instead of the exact expectation, fewer than six clean curves, or fewer than all three sizes and seeds.

primary: exact four- and eight-term support sizes with finite-null raw ranks, ties, and percentiles
coverage efficiency |8A|/|4A|^2 with finite-null raw ranks, ties, and percentiles
functional advice entries and deep bytes
per-target exact uniform-permutation first-hit work and four retained shuffled scans
exact uniform-order functional S*T^2/(epsilon*q) percentile against both null samples
offline group-operation, charged field-multiplication, and charged field-inversion ratios
secondary: factor-base construction, compiler field operations, and disclosed binary-pow/map proxies
measured lookup counts, assumed lookup traffic bytes, and enforced wrapper peak RSS
sampled successes and failed-target scan costs
measured Pollard-rho group operations as scale only

experiment.objective: Run an exploratory finite-null calibration of the verified sign-complete m=8 coverage signal on nine distinct-field non-special curves with exact uniform-order and charged coordinate-cost accounting.
stopping_rules: The harness must stop or invalidate a run at 900 seconds, 2 GiB peak RSS, two total runs, or four cumulative CPU-hours.
Stop a curve search after 256 coefficient attempts and retain an invalid run.
Do not promote a family unless it passes six of nine clean instances spanning all three sizes and all three seeds.
Do not call any percentile result split compression unless four-term support is at most 0.8x both null medians.
Do not fit an exponent from this null-calibration sweep.
experiment.success_criterion: Promote a family only if exact eight-term support and |8A|/|4A|^2 are at or above the 0.95 empirical percentile of both 31-replicate samples, the exact uniform-order functional frontier is at or above the 0.90 percentile of both samples, every sampled-order control is within 25 percent, each charged offline cost is at most 4.0x median random-x, all mandatory controls pass, and all conditions hold in at least six of nine distinct-field curves spanning every size and seed. This is an exploratory finite-null pass only.
experiment.title: Finite-null and exact-order recursive coverage calibration
